source.method: Cycle 34 frozen technical-document sections; retain heading plus a whitespace-bounded excerpt at most 512 UTF-16 code units. Repetitions are labeled and are not independent real documents.
source.limits: Single English technical self-documentation corpus, repeated excerpts and deterministic synthetic lexical controls; no representative traffic or relevance-quality claim.

method.content: Each frozen body value concatenated with newline into one custom static page per source ID; no phrase-boundary equivalence.
method.matching: Unmodified Pagefind language analysis/stemming/prefix search; not native NFKC token/exact semantics.
method.output: Timed search returns generated result handles/count. Complete untimed data() hydration captures original source IDs/URLs; not native ranked ID+score output cost.
method.build: Node native Pagefind indexing plus writeFiles; excludes browser launch/HTTP host.
method.queries: Single text and one prefix raw string only; unsupported operators retained explicitly.
method.quantiles: Nearest rank; p95 only if at least100 samples. Same-context warm repetitions; no population or heap/CPU claim.

queries.reason: Static Pagefind language/stemming/prefix model and generated index differ; native operators/phrases/transactions not emulated.
